def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    cars = image_patch.find("white car")
    buildings = image_patch.find("commercial building")
    
    if not cars or not buildings:
        return []
    
    car_centers = [(car.left + car.right) / 2 for car in cars]
    building_centers = [(building.left + building.right) / 2 for building in buildings]
    
    distances = [(abs(car_center - building_center), car, building) 
                 for car_center, building_center in zip(car_centers, building_centers)]
    
    distances.sort()
    
    return [distances[0][1], distances[0][2]]
